# Journalism AI v3.0.2

> Useful TypeScript functions for journalism projects. This library focuses on AI.

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-ai/v3.0.2/README.md): Installation, examples and usage.

## API
- [askGemini](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-ai/v3.0.2/docs/functions/askGemini.md): askGemini function
- [askGeminiPool](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-ai/v3.0.2/docs/functions/askGeminiPool.md): askGeminiPool function
- [askOllama](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-ai/v3.0.2/docs/functions/askOllama.md): askOllama function
- [getEmbedding](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-ai/v3.0.2/docs/functions/getEmbedding.md): getEmbedding function
- [getEmbeddingIdentity](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-ai/v3.0.2/docs/functions/getEmbeddingIdentity.md): getEmbeddingIdentity function
